dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture (generalization of 1.3 to bounded clique number)
dossier_meta.statement_text: The corresponding result to 1.3 is true for graphs with bounded clique number rather than just triangle-free graphs: for all integers $\nu > 0$ and $k \geq 3$ there exists $n$ such that if $G$ has no clique of cardinality $k$ and has chromatic number at least $n$, then for some $t$, $G$ has a hole of length $t+i$ for $1 \leq i \leq \nu$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Immediately after the statement of the main result (1.3), which establishes $\nu$ consecutive hole lengths for triangle-free graphs, the authors conjecture the same conclusion holds under the weaker assumption that $G$ has bounded clique number. They note they have made no progress in proving this.
